rituals.title: THE ATTENTION BOUNCER
rituals.name: THE ATTENTION BOUNCER
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PATTERN
Attention misallocation

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
MISSION
Not every thought gets the same access to your attention.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Spot Arrival — Notice the next thought without following it. Slow the movement down while you do it during spot arrival.
2. Stamp Access — Stamp it REQUESTED, RELEVANT, or UNINVITED.

rituals.title: PLAN BOTH BRANCHES
rituals.name: PLAN BOTH BRANCHES
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PATTERN
Uncertainty intolerance

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
MISSION
Uncertainty need not prevent preparation.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Plausible — Choose two plausible outcomes and build a short branch for each: first signal, first action, resource, and exit. Soften your grip while you stay with the thought during choose plausible.
2. Prepare Both — Prepare any step useful in both branches now. Ask what could also be true during prepare both.
3. Select Path — Delay preference until evidence selects the path.
⚡ FINISH — Select Path.
rituals.win_reward:
YOU WIN WHEN
✓ I can complete select path.
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Plausible → Prepare Both → Select Path
